title: Exact Boolean–Möbius endpoint transitions: quotient bits, support aggregation, and signed repair defect

concepts.label: single-rank quotient transition
concepts.note: The exact doubling-plus-divisibility-bit recurrence for one Mersenne quotient.

concepts.label: finite-support quotient transition
concepts.note: The summed recurrence whose new bit count is endpointDivisorContribution.

concepts.label: endpoint divisor contribution
concepts.note: The number of support ranks dividing the new endpoint.

concepts.label: signed endpoint defect
concepts.note: The integer difference between the half endpoint target and the support quotient.

concepts.label: local repair integer
concepts.note: The affine repair coordinate derived from the previous natural suffix.

concepts.label: below-target cast boundary
concepts.note: The hypothesis under which a natural suffix agrees with its signed integer defect.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For d at least two, localMersenneQuotient (M+1) d is twice localMersenneQuotient M d plus one exactly when d divides M+1, and plus zero otherwise.
statement_nodes.engine: exact floor-quotient doubling with one divisibility bit
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is a project-coordinate arithmetic identity.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The identity gives one quotient bit only; it proves no exact row, capacity inequality, sign, or cofinal support.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For a fixed finite support of ranks at least two, localPrefixQuotient D (M+1)=2*localPrefixQuotient D M+endpointDivisorContribution D (M+1).
statement_nodes.engine: finite summation of the rank-wise quotient-bit transition
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an internal exact transition identity.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: Fixing and summing a support does not construct one that hits the half target, and the theorem does not show that the contribution equals one.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: For M at least one and a finite support of ranks at least two, localEndpointDefect D (M+1)=2*localEndpointDefect D M+1-endpointDivisorContribution D (M+1).
statement_nodes.engine: subtraction of the quotient transition from the half-target transition
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: The identity normalizes the fixed-support transition in signed coordinates.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The defect is signed. The theorem proves no nonnegativity, boundedness, eventual behavior, exact row, or verified tempered-orbit identification.

statement_nodes.canonical_statement: If the endpoint-M prefix quotient has not crossed its half target, localRepairInteger D 1 (M+1) equals localEndpointDefect D (M+1).
statement_nodes.engine: cast of the below-target natural suffix into the signed defect recurrence
statement_nodes.prior_art_note: This is an exact conditional coordinate identification.
statement_nodes.scope_caveat: The theorem does not establish its below-target hypothesis and produces no feasible repair or exact row. It does not verify a tempered-orbit instance.

intra_zone_relations.basis: Summing the rank-wise transition over D turns the individual divisibility bits into endpointDivisorContribution D (M+1).
Subtracting the support-quotient transition from the half-endpoint-target transition yields the signed affine defect recurrence exactly.
Under the below-target hypothesis, the natural suffix casts to the signed current defect, so the repair expression becomes the next defect recurrence.
